author: Daniele Morais
title: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes near southern East Pacific Rise
seoTitle: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake near southern East Pacific Rise
subtitle: The quake was recorded at a depth of 10 km, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS).
excerpt: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake was recorded near southern East Pacific Rise, at a depth of 10 km, according to the USGS.
contentHtml:
A magnitude 5.9 earthquake was recorded on September 2, 2026 at 09:35 AM (Brasília time) near southern East Pacific Rise, according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). The quake occurred at a depth of roughly 10 km.

What this magnitude means

Earthquakes in this range are moderate and rarely cause severe structural damage, but are widely felt.

What to expect in the coming days

After a main shock, aftershocks — smaller quakes in the same region — are expected over the following days and weeks, with frequency decreasing over time, a well-established pattern in seismology.

With data from the USGS (United States Geological Survey).
